Louis Baartman III

By: Michael Duffett | Production

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Louis Baartman - the trilogy

Unique Selling Point:
Another episode on the man who leaves a trail of destruction, and continues to con people out of money - and everytime victims fall for his charm or tears.

Summary:
.He is serial con artist, the man with the golden tongue, he is a rogue who we have featured twice before - scam after scam, and he gets away with it - from admitting to running a ponzi scheme in some property market scheme where he blew 30 million of investor's money to lots of other scams too many to mention here, but will be featured in Program No 3. The lastest drama is that how he managed to start up his beloved Radio station but in the process allowed many students of his to be stranded in Thailand for a class he was supposed to teach - and how he has not paid his employees and they have recently stolen his transmitter.

Further information:
This man who started Radio Houtstock eventually gave over his Iscasa license to the station and the equipment to an attorney whom he owned lots of money, and then he vanished - ending up in Thailand. There, and in SA, he started to run a new venture, teaching South Africans on how to teach English for jobs in the far east and Thailand. He has taught about 200 students. The module he uses in quite low key called the TELF module. In one post in facebook he guaranteed jobs in Thailand. The rest of the story is like a runaway train, and the longer we wait, the more drama occurs with Baartman.

He desperately wanted to start up his radio station again, and at the time was friends with another Afrikaans radio presenter - Joanie, who pitied him and his wife and helped them survive. They stayed at her house for weeks. She says he offered her 50% of the radio station - and she would be the chief sponsorship getter. She would start being paid in Dec 2018 when the radio station started up on air;. She helped raise R170 000 in May 2018 for the station. - and R100 000 for the transmitter in Sept 2018.

Then PROBLEMS: 18 students were in Thailand where Baartman would teach his english course - only problems is that he did not turn up, and the students who had pre paid, including their accommodation were left stranded. Frantic calls were made to Baartman in SA to say - where are you? He had no money to come to Thailand, and he had to borrow R19 000 from Jan and Jana who had lent him the R100 000 for the transmitter. From SA, Baartman begged a SA hotel owner in Thailand to put up the students despite him not having paid a previous account. The owner Peter took pity on the students. Finally Baartman arrived a week later. And since he had not paid his rent for his premises in Thailand, the students had to do a crash course in the hotel.

Observing all of this was ANDRE who had helped secure the release of students in China, and featured on Carte Blanche. He was doing Baartman's course and realising that he was in financial trouble he offered to buy his business by taking over all his debt. Baartman agreed - then Baartman renegned and slipt out of the country, not paying his hotel bill for the students - once again.

HE came back to SA and started hassling with CLAUDE who had constructed the transmitter.Claude left for PE and took the transmitter. Legal stuff followed and Claude agreed to part with the transmitter for R25 000. It was to be delivered to ICASA, sealed, and Baartman could fetch it there and leave a R25 000 check. Only thing, Baartman intercepted the courier and never paid the R25 000.

The radio station started broadcasting - in DEC 2018 - Joanie was not paid for that month and she and Baartman had a huge fight. The cherry on the top was a voice recording that was accidentally recorded by her - of Baartman and his wife having a screaming match and slagging off Joanie (we need legal opinion here). Joanie left in disgust, and immediately went and had her furniture removed from his flat that was doubling up as a studio. She started plotting her revenge.

Baartman then hired radio announcer, offered them a contract of a certain amount per hour. They never got copies of the contracts despite them asking for them. They were not paid for 3 months. Suddenly Baartman sent them a whatts app saying that he had torn up the original contracts and that they must sign new ones and their salaries would be dependent on sponsorships they brought in. Peter the one radio presenter is furious. Elmarie too. She gave Baartman a chance because she believed his lies. Then a few weeks ago because she could not attend an evening meeting, Baartman fired her. Fired a woman who he had not paid for 3'/4 months. THAT WAS THE LAST STRAW.

She and Joanie got together - and spoke to Jan and Jana who had lent Baartman R100 000 for the transmitter. They had not been paid any interest at all from their loan to him, and they gave instructions to the 2 woman to remove the transmitter which was erected on a farm 100 k's away. They sped off, told the local police what they were going to do, and taking instructions from CLAUDE on cell (he is the one who made the transmitter) they managed to take off the equipment from a long pole. They have hidden it safety vowing never to give it back. They can also prove that Baartman frauded JAN and JANA when he got his loan from them, by showing him a ICAASA license that had already expired.

Baartman is besides himself - he knows it was Joanie who stole it, as a retired detective who accompanied the ladies on their mission, told him that it was her. Baartman is now shouting at the Police to arrest her - claiming that he will go to the media if they don't

Latest: Today I have just filmed the sheriff searching Joanie’ flat, lovely footage.
Also great footage of Baarrtman being told to voetsak.

How we transition from the previous 2 inserts is to say that He seemed to have disappeared, but popped up in Thailand. Youtube video of him doing a poor tourist video.

Monday – off to film ladies up country going to police station and also will interview them at the location where they removed the transmitter.

Phoning him this afternoon for an interview. Will send him questions if necessary and we know where he lives and works – door stop if necessary.

Press Release:


The Serial Conman Part 3
With staff and suppliers unpaid, a Cape Town radio station recently went off air when investors who felt they had been duped into parting with R100,000 for the running of the station, decided to take matters into their own hands and confiscate the transmitters from a mountain top outside the city. Carte Blanche investigates the new instalment in the story of a serial conman we’ve exposed twice before for running a property Ponzi scheme and leaving students stranded in Thailand – and we ask what will it take to end the trail of destruction?
Producer: Michael Duffett
Presenter: Derek Watts


Script:


SCRIPT

It’s like a scene from a Hollywood movie.,. Two ` women locate and remove a cape town radio’s stations broadcast transmitter

Link:
So who done it? It seems outrageous that two women can climb a mountain and sabotage a radio station, and cut if off from the airways. Well that station is Radio Houtstok FM. The owner, Louis Baartman, and he has featured a coupe of time on Care Blanche in the past.

We first met Baartman in2011 shortly after he had started Radio Houstock. We grilled him about the many allegations against him. He did not want to comment on his 1990 Pondorozo horse racing scheme where 1.4 million rand of investors vanished. Nor did he want to comment on Gary van den `berg who a couple of years ear had signed over his home to him before receiving payment. Baartman stripped his business of its assets and van den berg was left homeless. And in then early 2000’s hundreds of elderly pensioners lost their investments - when a property syndication company Baartman started collapsed. Batman even said on camera that he paid dividends from investor deposits which is akin to a Ponzi scheme,

And in part 2 we detailed many more of his scams – for example, when he held a fund raising event to 2012 to help RAISE money to buy an electric wheel chair for Franette Willemse..but he ran off with the proceeds.

We confronted him about the many allegations in 2013

.Derek: A lot of people have accused you of fleecing them, we would like to hear your story.
Baartman: Ok, I will speak to you, just let me finish this meeting and I will speak to you.

But he refused to comment…..… and drove off into the distance.

Link
And then things went quite. What happened to Louis? It turns out he went to Thailand, teaching South Africans students to teach English in a foreign language.

Between 2014 and 2018 Baartman taught the Telf teaching module to SA students in a classroom he had rented over there. But he still itched to get his radio station back. On one a visit to SA in 2017 he persuaded well know radio presenter Joani Allen to join him.

Joanie: In the beginning a very good one…. because I came up with all the ideas which he liked.

Joanie was offered a directorship, the post of station manager and a salary She managed to secure two major loans , one of which would pay for a transmitter costing R175000. But Claud van Ryst is an angry man. He was tasked with acquiring the transmitter.

Derek: you got nothing
Claude: yes you are right – nothing,

That’s R25 000 commission down the drain

Baartman set up his studio in his apartment he rented in Melkbosstrand. But he was supposed to be in Thailand in October 2018 to teach a course to 9 south African students who had each paid R18500 and that included accommodation., Baartman simply did not pitch up. The South Africans owners of the hotel where the students stayed wanted to evict the them.,

Peter: Luois then pleaded that we please don’t do this, and he promised that if there is one promise he will keep, and that he will pay him.

Louis final arrived in Phuket a week later and gave a crash course . Needless to say he did not pay Boshoff the R116 000 he owed him.


Then Baartman rushed back to South Africa to prepare for the launch of Radio Houtstock FM.

Allen: I said to Louis, we are ion air…..this is your last chance, ,don’t stuff it up. He promised me that he would not

According to Allen, he did just that.!!! She found some damning documents.

Allen: I went into the office and I took out some documents and I managed to find proof that he had been putting personal sponsorships into his personal account.

An outraged Allen who had not been paid a cent of salary left the station in disgust.

Despite a contact in place, it seems that Baartman never paid his radio presenters . Elmarie Potgieter worked for three months with no pay,

Derek: surely you needed the money
Elmarie: yes I did because I have got my shop over the weekends..but I need the income in the week.


Three angry people! ….Joani felt that Baartman had to be stopped. That chance came when a couple instructed Allen to remove the transmitter since Baartman had paid no interest on their R100 000 loan. .the transmitter had been put up as security.

On the 20th of May she and Potgieter headed off to Porterville 150 ‘ks from Cape ~Town. She informed the local police of her intentions and then it was up the mountain, Claude van der Ryst, back in `Port Eiizabeth gave them the coordinates_……….Accompanying them was a retired detective. The transmitter was housed in a container.)

Vqn der Ryst guided them by phone on how to disconnect the transmitter.(apparatus)

Van der ryst: well I was actually supposed to install the equipment so I knew exactly how to install the stuff and dismantle the stuff

Derek: did they sound stressed:they were very stressed at the moment.

The women were able to remove the all important apparatus

Derek: Did you not feel like criminals?

Joanie: Not at all, not at all. We had no guilt feeling.

Baartman found out that Allen was responsible and laid charges charges and managed to get a court order for her apartment to be searched. . Allen was not impressed that he arrived with the sherrif.

Allen: Get off my Property, I will call the police

The sheriff searched the property and left empty handed., The women were shaken up.

Elmarie: I am shivering with frustration. Because he gets away with it all the time..he will not get away with this for ever…. Mark my words.

Detectives asked Allen to present herself at the police Porterville police station. `she arrived last Monday armed with documents. They women were inside for an hour.

Derek: Elma and Lious are back: they did not lock you up?

Joanie: Hello Derek not at all, it actually went very well…. At the police station.

Allen showed the detectives the loan agreement for the purchase the transmitter. She had signed for it In 2018. Baartman had earlier handed over the same agreement to detectives. Allen says that he had replaced her signature with his own.!!!!!

Derek: Did they ask you where the transmitter was?

Joanie: They did ask, and we said we have no idea

Derek: You still are staying stum?
Joanie: Not in our possession!


It was time to ask Baartman questions and hear his side of the story. We had already sent him a list of allegations.

Lious : Yes
How you doing? It’s Derek.
I have nothing to say to you, talk to my lawyer

We sent allegations to his attorney. he said he was only mandated to talk about the alleged theft of the transmitter .. but since the case was sub judice, he wouldn’t comment.

We urged Baartman to respond to the other allegations but we got no response from him.


In the meantime, confusion reigns! – who actually owns the transmitter? And where is it? Allen has laid charged of fraud against Baartman and hopes a court will (finally) put a stop to his ways.

Joani: Baartman is such a con man. People believe in him. They still do.

Elmarie Potgieter worked for three months with no pay, Derek: surely you needed the money Elmarie: yes I did because I have got my shop over the weekends..but I need the income in the week. Three angry people! ….Joani felt that Baartman had to be stopped. That chance came when a couple instructed Allen to remove the transmitter since Baartman had paid no interest on their R100 000 loan. .the transmitter had been put up as security. On the 20th of May she and Potgieter headed off to Porterville 150 ‘ks from Cape ~Town. She informed the local police of her intentions and then it was up the mountain, Claude van der Ryst, back in `Port Eiizabeth gave them the coordinates_……….Accompanying them was a retired detective. The transmitter was housed in a container.) Vqn der Ryst guided them by phone on how to disconnect the transmitter.(apparatus) Van der ryst: well I was actually supposed to install the equipment so I knew exactly how to install the stuff and dismantle the stuff Derek: did they sound stressed:they were very stressed at the moment. The women were able to remove the all important apparatus Derek: Did you not feel like criminals? Joanie: Not at all, not at all. We had no guilt feeling. Baartman found out that Allen was responsible and laid charges charges and managed to get a court order for her apartment to be searched. . Allen was not impressed that he arrived with the sherrif. Allen: Get off my Property, I will call the police The sheriff searched the property and left empty handed., The women were shaken up. Elmarie: I am shivering with frustration. Because he gets away with it all the time..he will not get away with this for ever…. Mark my words. Detectives asked Allen to present herself at the police Porterville police station. `she arrived last Monday armed with documents. They women were inside for an hour. Derek: Elma and Lious are back: they did not lock you up? Joanie: Hello Derek not at all, it actually went very well…. At the police station. Allen showed the detectives the loan agreement for the purchase the transmitter. She had signed for it In 2018. Baartman had earlier handed over the same agreement to detectives. Allen says that he had replaced her signature with his own.!!!!! Derek: Did they ask you where the transmitter was? Joanie: They did ask, and we said we have no idea Derek: You still are staying stum? Joanie: Not in our possession! It was time to ask Baartman questions and hear his side of the story. We had already sent him a list of allegations. Lious : Yes How you doing? It’s Derek. I have nothing to say to you, talk to my lawyer We sent allegations to his attorney. he said he was only mandated to talk about the alleged theft of the transmitter .. but since the case was sub judice, he wouldn’t comment. We urged Baartman to respond to the other allegations but we got no response from him. In the meantime, confusion reigns! – who actually owns the transmitter? And where is it? Allen has laid charged of fraud against Baartman and hopes a court will (finally) put a stop to his ways. Joani: Baartman is such a con man. People believe in him. They still do. metadata.Unique Selling Point: Another episode on the man who leaves a trail of destruction, and continues to con people out of money - and everytime victims fall for his charm or tears.
metadata.Summary: .He is serial con artist, the man with the golden tongue, he is a rogue who we have featured twice before - scam after scam, and he gets away with it - from admitting to running a ponzi scheme in some property market scheme where he blew 30 million of investor's money to lots of other scams too many to mention here, but will be featured in Program No 3. The lastest drama is that how he managed to start up his beloved Radio station but in the process allowed many students of his to be stranded in Thailand for a class he was supposed to teach - and how he has not paid his employees and they have recently stolen his transmitter.
metadata.Further information: This man who started Radio Houtstock eventually gave over his Iscasa license to the station and the equipment to an attorney whom he owned lots of money, and then he vanished - ending up in Thailand. There, and in SA, he started to run a new venture, teaching South Africans on how to teach English for jobs in the far east and Thailand. He has taught about 200 students. The module he uses in quite low key called the TELF module. In one post in facebook he guaranteed jobs in Thailand. The rest of the story is like a runaway train, and the longer we wait, the more drama occurs with Baartman. He desperately wanted to start up his radio station again, and at the time was friends with another Afrikaans radio presenter - Joanie, who pitied him and his wife and helped them survive. They stayed at her house for weeks. She says he offered her 50% of the radio station - and she would be the chief sponsorship getter. She would start being paid in Dec 2018 when the radio station started up on air;. She helped raise R170 000 in May 2018 for the station. - and R100 000 for the transmitter in Sept 2018. Then PROBLEMS: 18 students were in Thailand where Baartman would teach his english course - only problems is that he did not turn up, and the students who had pre paid, including their accommodation were left stranded. Frantic calls were made to Baartman in SA to say - where are you? He had no money to come to Thailand, and he had to borrow R19 000 from Jan and Jana who had lent him the R100 000 for the transmitter. From SA, Baartman begged a SA hotel owner in Thailand to put up the students despite him not having paid a previous account. The owner Peter took pity on the students. Finally Baartman arrived a week later. And since he had not paid his rent for his premises in Thailand, the students had to do a crash course in the hotel. Observing all of this was ANDRE who had helped secure the release of students in China, and featured on Carte Blanche. He was doing Baartman's course and realising that he was in financial trouble he offered to buy his business by taking over all his debt. Baartman agreed - then Baartman renegned and slipt out of the country, not paying his hotel bill for the students - once again. HE came back to SA and started hassling with CLAUDE who had constructed the transmitter.Claude left for PE and took the transmitter. Legal stuff followed and Claude agreed to part with the transmitter for R25 000. It was to be delivered to ICASA, sealed, and Baartman could fetch it there and leave a R25 000 check. Only thing, Baartman intercepted the courier and never paid the R25 000. The radio station started broadcasting - in DEC 2018 - Joanie was not paid for that month and she and Baartman had a huge fight. The cherry on the top was a voice recording that was accidentally recorded by her - of Baartman and his wife having a screaming match and slagging off Joanie (we need legal opinion here). Joanie left in disgust, and immediately went and had her furniture removed from his flat that was doubling up as a studio. She started plotting her revenge. Baartman then hired radio announcer, offered them a contract of a certain amount per hour. They never got copies of the contracts despite them asking for them. They were not paid for 3 months. Suddenly Baartman sent them a whatts app saying that he had torn up the original contracts and that they must sign new ones and their salaries would be dependent on sponsorships they brought in. Peter the one radio presenter is furious. Elmarie too. She gave Baartman a chance because she believed his lies. Then a few weeks ago because she could not attend an evening meeting, Baartman fired her. Fired a woman who he had not paid for 3'/4 months. THAT WAS THE LAST STRAW. She and Joanie got together - and spoke to Jan and Jana who had lent Baartman R100 000 for the transmitter. They had not been paid any interest at all from their loan to him, and they gave instructions to the 2 woman to remove the transmitter which was erected on a farm 100 k's away. They sped off, told the local police what they were going to do, and taking instructions from CLAUDE on cell (he is the one who made the transmitter) they managed to take off the equipment from a long pole. They have hidden it safety vowing never to give it back. They can also prove that Baartman frauded JAN and JANA when he got his loan from them, by showing him a ICAASA license that had already expired. Baartman is besides himself - he knows it was Joanie who stole it, as a retired detective who accompanied the ladies on their mission, told him that it was her. Baartman is now shouting at the Police to arrest her - claiming that he will go to the media if they don't Latest: Today I have just filmed the sheriff searching Joanie’ flat, lovely footage. Also great footage of Baarrtman being told to voetsak. How we transition from the previous 2 inserts is to say that He seemed to have disappeared, but popped up in Thailand. Youtube video of him doing a poor tourist video. Monday – off to film ladies up country going to police station and also will interview them at the location where they removed the transmitter. Phoning him this afternoon for an interview. Will send him questions if necessary and we know where he lives and works – door stop if necessary.
